use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool is
    if value < 2 then return false fi

    let divisor mut = 2

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0 then return false fi
        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    true
si

smooth(bound: int, count: int) -> LIST[bigint] is
    let factors = (2::bound) |> filter(is_prime)
                             |> map(p => bigint(p))
                             |> collect_list()

    let found = LIST()
    found.add(1n)

    let next_index = LIST()

    for _ in factors do
        next_index.add(0)
    od

    while found.count < count do
        let smallest mut = found[next_index[0]] * factors[0]

        for which in 1..factors.count do
            let candidate = found[next_index[which]] * factors[which]

            if candidate < smallest then
                smallest = candidate
            fi
        od

        for which in 0..factors.count do
            if found[next_index[which]] * factors[which] =~ smallest then
                next_index[which] = next_index[which] + 1
            fi
        od

        found.add(smallest)
    od

    found
si

let bounds = (2::29) |> filter(is_prime) |> collect_list()

write_line("the first 25 n-smooth numbers:")

for bound in bounds do
    let terms = smooth(bound, 25) |> map(value => "{value}") |> join(" ")

    write_line("  {bound,2}: {terms}")
od

write_line("")
write_line("the 3000th to 3002nd n-smooth numbers:")

for bound in bounds |> filter(b => b >= 3) do
    let found = smooth(bound, 3_002)
    let terms = found[2_999..3_002] |> map(value => "{value}") |> join(" ")

    write_line("  {bound,2}: {terms}")
od
